score_definition: 호감도 긍정평가와 국정수행 능력 긍정평가의 평균

primary_online_source.recovery_note: 본문 텍스트에는 1~10위와 이인제 22위가 직접 서술되어 있으나 11~31위 전체 표/그래픽은 검색·텍스트 전송본에 포함되지 않음

issue_identification.basis: 별도 재전송/인용 자료에서 한겨레21 제528호가 2004-09-22자로 확인되며 이 기사의 2004-09-20 전송 시점과 일치하는 발행주기

rejected_reconstruction_methods: Do not infer membership from contemporary prominence alone.
Do not treat search-engine return for article-title + candidate as evidence of candidate inclusion because query terms may be ignored/loosely matched.
Do not borrow ranks from other 2004 surveys such as KSOI or other media polls.
Do not fabricate ranks 11~31 from later political prominence.

next_retrieval_gate.preferred_source: physical or digitized scan of the Hankyoreh21 issue containing the article/table
next_retrieval_gate.likely_target: late-September 2004 issue, likely no. 528 but issue number must be verified from the scan
next_retrieval_gate.needed_artifact: page image/PDF showing the 31-candidate ranking table or candidate list
next_retrieval_gate.on_retrieval: transcribe all 31 names/ranks/scores with page-level provenance, then build h21_2004_full31 roster and extend Type-A common master
